name: Spondyloepimetaphyseal Dysplasia-Short Limb-Abnormal Calcification Syndrome
aliases: Spondyloepimetaphyseal Dysplasia with Short Limbs and Abnormal Calcification

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Radiological Diagnostic Criteria for SEMD-SL-AC Syndrome

criteria.description: Presence of disproportionate short stature with short limbs
Radiological evidence of abnormal calcification in epiphyseal and metaphyseal regions
Presence of platyspondyly and other vertebral anomalies on imaging
Identification of pathogenic variants in associated genes (e.g., COL2A1 or others if known)
Additional skeletal abnormalities such as metaphyseal irregularities and joint contractures

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of all three major criteria (short limbs, abnormal calcification on imaging, vertebral malformations) with supportive clinical and/or genetic findings
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic heterogeneity may exist; molecular confirmation supports diagnosis but is not mandatory.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Disproportionate short stature with short limbs
searchTerms: short stature with disproportionately short limbs
disproportionate short height due to limb shortening

pathognomonic.symptomName: Abnormal calcification in epiphyseal and metaphyseal regions
searchTerms: abnormal calcium deposits in joint bones
widened and irregular metaphyseal bone areas
abnormal bone shape near joint ends

common.symptomName: Joint contractures and limited range of motion

occasional.symptomName: Respiratory complications secondary to thoracic cage abnormalities
searchTerms: breathing issues due to chest wall deformities
respiratory problems from rib cage abnormalities

rare.symptomName: Ophthalmological abnormalities such as myopia or retinal detachment
Neurological complications due to spinal cord compression

imaging: Radiographs showing platyspondyly, metaphyseal irregularities, and abnormal calcifications
MRI may reveal spinal cord compression in advanced cases
other: Clinical examination revealing disproportionate short stature and joint contractures

distinguishingFeatures: Predominantly epiphyseal involvement without abnormal calcification
Different genetic mutations (COL2A1 variants with distinct phenotype)

redFlags: Rapid progression of spinal deformities with neurological symptoms
Severe respiratory insufficiency due to thoracic cage abnormalities
Early onset joint contractures leading to significant functional impairment
references: Orphanet: Spondyloepimetaphyseal Dysplasia-Short Limb-Abnormal Calcification Syndrome, ORPHA:93358
Superti-Furga A, Unger S. Nosology and classification of genetic skeletal disorders: 2019 revision. Am J Med Genet A. 2019.
